request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Recolour only his skin: the pale khaki skin of his face, ears, arms and hands becomes a mid-tone grey-green, colour #6b7d45, with shadows only a little darker, #46552e: clearly green, not yellow, not black, and the face stays clearly visible. Keep everything else exactly the same: the horned helmet, tusks, open mouth, the brown hide cape and leather tunic, the shoulder plates, the tin megaphone, belt, boots, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style.
